name: user_simulation
description: Conversation scenarios for subscription_agent. An LLM plays the customer; there are no fixed user turns or reference answers.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: I want to cancel my subscription. Now.
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You want to cancel your subscription. Your account email is sam@example.com; give it when asked. Refuse any discount or retention offer, however generous. Once the agent confirms the subscription is cancelled, the conversation is over.

user_persona.description: A customer who has already decided to leave and is annoyed at being slowed down.

behaviors.name: Short and blunt
behaviors.description: Replies are short, blunt and slightly annoyed, but never abusive.
behavior_instructions: Reply in one or two short sentences.
Do not thank the agent or use polite filler.
violation_rubrics: The user response is longer than two sentences.
The user response is abusive or insulting.

behaviors.name: Refuses retention offers
behaviors.description: The customer turns down every discount or offer.
behavior_instructions: Decline any discount, pause or downgrade the agent offers.
violation_rubrics: The user accepts or shows interest in a discount or offer.

behaviors.name: Ends the conversation
behaviors.description: A custom persona must say when the conversation is over; the pre-built personas include this behavior.
behavior_instructions: When the agent has completed everything in the Conversation Plan, reply with `{{ stop_signal }}` and nothing else.
violation_rubrics: The conversation plan is complete, but the user response did not use `{{ stop_signal }}`.

rubric_content.text_property: By the end of the conversation the agent has cancelled the subscription and told the customer when access ends.
The agent makes at most one retention offer and does not repeat it after the customer declines.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hi, I'm thinking about cancelling. It's getting a bit expensive for me.
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You are considering cancelling because of the price. Your account email is priya@example.com; give it when asked. If the agent offers a discount, accept it and do not cancel. Once the agent confirms the discount is applied, the conversation is over.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent applies the retention discount and does not cancel the subscription.
